title: Attackers Use Autonomous AI to Target Semiconductor, Defense and Civil Society Sectors
description: Between August and September 2026, Chinese-speaking attackers used the open-source AI penetration testing framework Cairn, combined with Chinese AI models Zhipu GLM and DeepSeek, to autonomously conduct 25 operations against at least 19 organizations in semiconductor manufacturing, U.S. defense policy, and civil society sectors. These attacks resulted in unauthorized access or data retrieval at 10 organizations, including credential theft, exposure of over one million personal records, retrieval of military and government identities, creation of persistent admin accounts, and modification of industry documents. The attackers used Cairn to autonomously plan and execute multi-stage attack operations with minimal human intervention. This activity is assessed with moderate confidence as China-nexus intelligence collection tracked as CL-STA-1238.
